summary: Atari Games' 1989 polygonal tunnel racer and shooter, built on an evolution of Hard Drivin' hardware and later converted to home computers and Lynx.

entries.title: S.T.U.N. Runner

emulation.notes: Use the arcade version for primary; cabinet controls and display framing are part of the original presentation.
emulation.fidelity_ceiling: Arcade-accurate polygonal output with modern display scaling

primary.why: S.T.U.N. Runner was designed as a custom arcade cabinet for Atari's polygonal tunnel-racing hardware. Home computer and Lynx ports are lower-fidelity conversions, while later Midway compilations are access routes to the arcade game.
primary.how_to_play: Play the arcade version in MAME/original hardware; Midway Arcade Treasures 3 or Deluxe Edition are compilation routes if owned.

all_releases.fidelity: Original Atari arcade cabinet and hardware.
